title: Preparation method and application of tin oxide/nano ZSM-5 composite material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of a gas-sensing material, in particular to a preparation method and application of a tin oxide/nano ZSM-5 composite material. Nano-sized ZSM-5 type zeolite is synthesized by using a hydrothermal method, and the prepared zeolite is compounded with SnO2 by using a dipping method, so that SnO2 particles with a particle size of 10 nm are formed on the surface of the zeolite through a principle of spontaneous monolayer dispersion, and the obtained material is adopted as a gas-sensing material for manufacturing a gas sensor; a side-heating gas sensor canbe manufactured by coating exterior of the composite material with another layer of nano ZSM-5 material, and it is found after tests that the response value of the sensor to formaldehyde is improvedgreatly, and a good effect of inhibition on acetone can be achieved.
